name: huemn-ai-recorder
description: Enterprise-grade Browser Recorder for Huemn AI

scripts.build: esbuild src/background/background.ts --bundle --outfile=public/background.js --target=chrome100 --minify && esbuild src/content/recorder.ts --bundle --outfile=public/recorder.js --target=chrome100 --minify && esbuild src/popup/popup.ts --bundle --outfile=public/popup.js --target=chrome100 --minify
scripts.watch: esbuild src/background/background.ts --bundle --outfile=public/background.js --target=chrome100 --sourcemap --watch & esbuild src/content/recorder.ts --bundle --outfile=public/recorder.js --target=chrome100 --sourcemap --watch & esbuild src/popup/popup.ts --bundle --outfile=public/popup.js --target=chrome100 --sourcemap --watch
scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently "npm run watch" "npm run launch"
